The real problem

It is not one problem. It is two.

Most agents treat this as a single retention issue. It is actually two separate problems, and they need two separate fixes.

#1 — staying top of mind

Clients do not come back.

Only 18% of past clients use the same agent again. It is not because they were unhappy. The gap comes down to one thing: agents go quiet after closing, and without a reason to stay connected, clients move on. You fall out of sight, and out of mind.

High effort. High cost. Low return.

You are already spending 300 to 600 dollars per client per year trying to fix this: mailers, pop-bys, closing gifts, newsletters. Low frequency, high cost, and none of it sticks past a few weeks.

The real problem

You funded the loan.
Someone else gets the refi.

Most borrowers don't leave because of a bad experience. They leave because you went quiet — and when rates moved, you had no idea they were ready.

#1 — Staying top of mind

Borrowers do not come back.

Roughly 68% of borrowers who refinance do it with a different lender. It is not because they were unhappy with their loan. You go quiet the moment it closes, and by the time rates make a refinance worth it, they call whoever is in front of them. You fall out of sight, and out of mind.

68 of every 100 refis
close with someone other than their original lender
#2 — No signal before they shop

You can't see who is warming up.

Borrowers don't decide to refinance or buy a new home overnight. For weeks they check their home value, run the numbers on their equity and play with mortgage calculators — long before they call anyone. Without a way to see that activity, you only find out they were ready after they close with someone else.

For Homeowners

Your biggest investment
deserves a plan.

Hearthward is the all-in-one home management app that helps you maintain, protect and grow the biggest asset you will ever own — with your real estate agent and lender just one tap away.

Get early access

The problem

You just bought your biggest asset.
Nobody handed you the manual.

Buying a home is one of the biggest financial decisions you will ever make. The day you get the keys, you also get a furnace, a water heater, a roof, a sprinkler system and a dozen appliances — each with its own schedule, its own warranty and its own way of breaking.

Most homeowners learn how to take care of a house the hard way. A furnace that quits in January. A water heater that floods the basement. A roof that should have been inspected two years ago. The small, inexpensive maintenance gets missed, and it quietly turns into big, expensive repairs.

It is not because you are careless. It is because you don't know what you don't know.

What needs to be done — and when

Filters, flushes, inspections and seasonal checks. Nobody tells you the schedule, so most of it never happens until something fails.

What actually adds value

Your home is your largest investment, yet most owners don't know what it is worth today, how much equity they have, or which upgrades are worth the money.

Who you can trust

When something breaks, you are left searching online for a contractor and hoping for the best. Quality work at a fair price usually comes down to who you know.

The result: avoidable repairs, value left on the table, and a lot of stress over the one thing you own that matters most.
The solution

One app for everything
your home needs.

Hearthward is an all-in-one home management app. It tells you what to do and when to do it, who to call when you need help, and what your home is worth — all in one place, right on your phone.

Maintenance

Never miss maintenance again.

Add the key systems and appliances in your home — HVAC, water heater, roof, sprinklers, refrigerator, washer and more — and Hearthward builds a maintenance schedule for each one. You get a reminder before things are due, and every finished job is saved to your home's history.

  • Pre-built schedules for every major home system
  • Custom reminders for any appliance you add
  • A complete maintenance record with notes, photos and costs
  • Assign tasks to anyone in your household
Trusted contractors

Know exactly who to call.

When something breaks, you should not have to gamble on a stranger. Hearthward gives you local, vetted contractors recommended by your real estate agent — or load in the pros you have already used and trust.

  • Contractors recommended by your real estate agent
  • Add your own go-to pros from past jobs
  • Synced with Google reviews
  • One tap to call, text or visit their website
Home value

See what your home is worth — today.

Watch your home's value as the market moves, see your equity grow over time, and run the numbers before you make a big decision.

  • Live home value estimate and trend
  • Equity snapshot that updates with the market
  • Mortgage and refinance calculators
  • Tips on which improvements add the most value
Your home, organized

Everything about your home, in one place.

Stop digging through email and filing cabinets. Keep your closing documents, inspection report, warranties and insurance policies stored securely — and share the work of running your home with the people who help you.

  • Secure vault for every home document
  • Invite family, a partner or a property manager to share tasks
  • Add multiple properties — perfect if you own rentals
  • One account for every home you own
The best part

You're not doing this alone.

Hearthward connects you with the two people who know your home best: the real estate agent who helped you buy it, and the lender who financed it. They are right inside the app whenever you need them.

Our story

We built Hearthward because we needed it.

Over ten years ago, we bought our first home. We were excited, grateful, and completely clueless about what it actually meant to own it. Our agent was wonderful — patient, knowledgeable, a trusted friend. Then closing day came. And that was that.

We learned about home maintenance the way most homeowners do: through costly mistakes. A water heater that hadn't been flushed in years. A furnace filter untouched since move-in. A roof that probably could have held on longer with one annual inspection.

The information existed. The expertise existed — in the head of our agent, the people we trusted most with our biggest purchase. What didn't exist was a way to stay connected, to keep that expertise accessible, to make homeownership feel managed rather than reactive. That's why Hearthward exists.

Our mission

To make homeownership feel like something you've got handled.

We believe every homeowner deserves a knowledgeable friend in their corner — someone who knows their home, their mortgage, their market. Hearthward makes that permanent.

What we believe

Four principles we build everything around.

🤝
Trust
Every contractor recommendation, every piece of guidance — rooted in genuine relationships and vetted expertise, not commissions.
💪
Empowerment
Homeowners deserve the confidence to make good decisions about their biggest asset. We give them the information to do it.
✨
Simplicity
Complex home management, made intuitive. Clean design, clear guidance, and organized information — built for real people, not IT professionals.
🔗
Partnership
The relationship between a homeowner and their agent shouldn't end at closing. We make sure it doesn't.
The problem we solve

The most important relationship in real estate ends at the wrong moment.

Homeowners trust their agent more than almost any professional in their lives — more than their doctor for the biggest financial decision they'll ever make. Then closing day arrives, the champagne is poured, and that relationship quietly ends.

The result: 91% of buyers say they'd use their agent again¹ — but only around 18% actually do². Not because they were unhappy — because the relationship quietly faded. Not because they were unhappy — because they simply lost touch. Life moved on. The relationship faded.

For agents, that's $47,000 in average commission lost per missed repeat transaction. For lenders, it's a refinance going to a competitor the moment rates shift. For homeowners, it's navigating their largest investment without guidance.

Hearthward solves all three problems at once.
